faqPairs.question: 無料で試せますか？
faqPairs.answer: 無料プランはありません。月額プランを選んで登録すると、アプリとWebの両方を使えます。料金はホームの料金欄をご覧ください。

faqPairs.question: アカウントを作る前に、アプリだけ入れてもいいですか？
faqPairs.answer: 入れることはできますが、ログインにはSIMYのアカウントが必要です。先にアカウントを作ってから、アプリの「ログイン」を押すのがいちばん早い順番です。

faqPairs.question: 登録には何が必要ですか？
faqPairs.answer: メールアドレスとクレジットカードです。届いたメールのリンクで本人確認をするので、パスワードは決めなくて構いません。支払いはカード決済の画面で行います。

faqPairs.question: アプリで「ログイン」を押したら「Unauthorized」と出ました。
faqPairs.answer: ブラウザでSIMYにログインしていない状態です。先にWebでログイン（はじめての方はアカウント作成）をしてから、アプリの「ログイン」をもう一度押してください。

faqPairs.question: Claude CodeやCodexを使っていなくても、入れる意味はありますか？
faqPairs.answer: 会議やチャットから仕事を拾う機能はWebだけで使えるので、アプリは必須ではありません。PCでClaude CodeやCodexを使っている方は、アプリを入れると会話が提案になり、SIMYからPCのAIを動かせます。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPTやClaudeの契約は必要ですか？
faqPairs.answer: SIMYのクラウド実行は、お使いのChatGPTアカウント（Codex）で動きます。PCのClaude Codeを動かすときは、あなたのClaude Codeのログインがそのまま使われます。Claudeのトークンをクラウド実行に連携することはできません。Geminiのトークン連携は開発中です。

faqPairs.question: IntelのMacでも使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 現在のMac版はAppleシリコン（M1以降）向けです。IntelのMacでは、Webから SIMY をお使いください。

faqPairs.question: ダウンロードしたファイル名が「SIMY-CLI」になっています。
faqPairs.answer: 同じものです。デスクトップアプリには、エンジニア向けにターミナルから使える SIMY CLI も入っているため、ファイル名にその名前が付いています。ふだんはアプリの画面だけで使えます。

faqPairs.question: Can I try it for free?
faqPairs.answer: There is no free plan. Choose a monthly plan and sign up to use both the app and the web. See pricing on the home page.

faqPairs.question: Can I install the app before creating an account?
faqPairs.answer: You can install it, but logging in requires a SIMY account. The fastest order is to create an account first, then click "Log in" in the app.

faqPairs.question: What do I need to sign up?
faqPairs.answer: An email address and a credit card. You verify yourself through the link in the email we send, so there's no password to set. Payment happens on the card checkout screen.

faqPairs.question: I clicked "Log in" in the app and saw "Unauthorized."
faqPairs.answer: You're not logged in to SIMY in your browser. Log in on the web first (or create an account if you're new), then click "Log in" in the app again.

faqPairs.question: Is the app worth installing if I don't use Claude Code or Codex?
faqPairs.answer: Picking up work from meetings and chats works on the web alone, so the app is optional. If you use Claude Code or Codex on your computer, installing the app turns those conversations into suggestions and lets SIMY run the AI on your computer.

faqPairs.question: Do I need a ChatGPT or Claude subscription?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY's cloud runs use your own ChatGPT account (Codex). When SIMY runs Claude Code on your computer, it uses your existing Claude Code login. Claude tokens cannot be connected for cloud runs. Gemini token support is in development.

faqPairs.question: Does it work on Intel Macs?
faqPairs.answer: The current Mac version is for Apple silicon (M1 or later). On an Intel Mac, please use SIMY on the web.

faqPairs.question: The downloaded file is named "SIMY-CLI."
faqPairs.answer: It's the same app. The desktop app also includes SIMY CLI, which engineers can use from the terminal, so the file carries that name. Day to day, you only need the app window.

faqPairs.question: ¿Puedo probarlo gratis?
faqPairs.answer: No hay plan gratuito. Al registrarte con un plan mensual puedes usar tanto la app como la web. Consulta los precios en la sección de precios de la página de inicio.

faqPairs.question: ¿Puedo instalar la app antes de crear la cuenta?
faqPairs.answer: Puedes instalarla, pero para iniciar sesión necesitas una cuenta de SIMY. Lo más rápido es crear la cuenta primero y luego pulsar «Iniciar sesión» en la app.

faqPairs.question: ¿Qué necesito para registrarme?
faqPairs.answer: Un correo electrónico y una tarjeta de crédito. Confirmas tu identidad con el enlace que te llega por correo, así que no necesitas crear una contraseña. El pago se hace en la pantalla de pago con tarjeta.

faqPairs.question: Al pulsar «Iniciar sesión» en la app, aparece «Unauthorized».
faqPairs.answer: No has iniciado sesión en SIMY en el navegador. Primero inicia sesión en la web (o crea tu cuenta si eres nuevo) y vuelve a pulsar «Iniciar sesión» en la app.

faqPairs.question: Si no uso Claude Code ni Codex, ¿tiene sentido instalarla?
faqPairs.answer: La función de recoger trabajo de reuniones y chats funciona solo con la web, así que la app no es imprescindible. Si usas Claude Code o Codex en tu PC, con la app tus conversaciones se convierten en propuestas y SIMY puede poner a trabajar la IA de tu PC.

faqPairs.question: ¿Necesito una suscripción a ChatGPT o Claude?
faqPairs.answer: La ejecución en la nube de SIMY funciona con tu cuenta de ChatGPT (Codex). Cuando SIMY pone a trabajar Claude Code en tu PC, usa tu propia sesión de Claude Code. No se puede vincular el token de Claude a la ejecución en la nube. La vinculación del token de Gemini está en desarrollo.

faqPairs.question: ¿Funciona en un Mac con procesador Intel?
faqPairs.answer: La versión actual para Mac es para Apple silicon (M1 o posterior). En un Mac con Intel, usa SIMY desde la web.

faqPairs.question: El archivo descargado se llama «SIMY-CLI».
faqPairs.answer: Es la misma app. La app de escritorio incluye también SIMY CLI, para quienes trabajan desde la terminal, y por eso el archivo lleva ese nombre. Para el uso diario basta con la interfaz de la app.

faqPairs.question: Peut-on essayer gratuitement ?
faqPairs.answer: Il n'y a pas d'offre gratuite. En choisissant une offre mensuelle à l'inscription, vous avez accès à l'application et au Web. Les tarifs sont sur la page d'accueil, section Tarifs.

faqPairs.question: Peut-on installer l'application avant de créer un compte ?
faqPairs.answer: Oui, mais il faut un compte SIMY pour se connecter. Le plus rapide : créer le compte d'abord, puis cliquer sur « Connexion » dans l'application.

faqPairs.question: Que faut-il pour s'inscrire ?
faqPairs.answer: Une adresse e-mail et une carte bancaire. L'identité est confirmée par un lien envoyé par e-mail : pas besoin de choisir un mot de passe. Le paiement se fait sur l'écran de paiement par carte.

faqPairs.question: J'ai cliqué sur « Connexion » dans l'application et « Unauthorized » s'est affiché.
faqPairs.answer: Vous n'êtes pas connecté à SIMY dans le navigateur. Connectez-vous d'abord sur le Web (ou créez un compte si c'est votre première fois), puis cliquez à nouveau sur « Connexion » dans l'application.

faqPairs.question: L'application est-elle utile si je n'utilise ni Claude Code ni Codex ?
faqPairs.answer: Repérer le travail dans les réunions et les discussions fonctionne avec le Web seul : l'application n'est pas indispensable. Si vous utilisez Claude Code ou Codex sur votre ordinateur, l'application transforme vos conversations en propositions, et SIMY peut faire travailler l'IA de votre ordinateur.

faqPairs.question: Faut-il un abonnement ChatGPT ou Claude ?
faqPairs.answer: L'exécution dans le cloud de SIMY passe par votre compte ChatGPT (Codex). Pour faire travailler Claude Code sur votre ordinateur, votre propre connexion à Claude Code est utilisée telle quelle. Les tokens Claude ne peuvent pas être reliés à l'exécution dans le cloud. La liaison des tokens Gemini est en cours de développement.

faqPairs.question: Fonctionne-t-elle sur un Mac Intel ?
faqPairs.answer: La version Mac actuelle est conçue pour les puces Apple (M1 ou plus récent). Sur un Mac Intel, utilisez SIMY depuis le Web.

faqPairs.question: Le fichier téléchargé s'appelle « SIMY-CLI ».
faqPairs.answer: C'est bien la même application. L'application de bureau contient aussi la SIMY CLI, utilisable dans le terminal par les développeurs, d'où ce nom de fichier. Au quotidien, l'interface de l'application suffit.

faqPairs.question: क्या मुफ़्त में आज़मा सकते हैं?
faqPairs.answer: कोई फ़्री प्लान नहीं है। मासिक प्लान चुनकर रजिस्टर करने पर ऐप और वेब दोनों इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं। कीमत होम पेज के प्राइसिंग सेक्शन में देखें।

faqPairs.question: क्या खाता बनाने से पहले सिर्फ़ ऐप इंस्टॉल कर सकते हैं?
faqPairs.answer: इंस्टॉल तो कर सकते हैं, पर लॉग इन के लिए SIMY खाता चाहिए। सबसे तेज़ तरीका है: पहले खाता बनाएँ, फिर ऐप में "लॉग इन" दबाएँ।

faqPairs.question: रजिस्ट्रेशन के लिए क्या चाहिए?
faqPairs.answer: ईमेल पता और क्रेडिट कार्ड। पहचान की पुष्टि ईमेल में आए लिंक से होती है, इसलिए पासवर्ड बनाने की ज़रूरत नहीं। भुगतान कार्ड पेमेंट स्क्रीन पर होता है।

faqPairs.question: ऐप में "लॉग इन" दबाने पर "Unauthorized" दिखा।
faqPairs.answer: इसका मतलब है कि ब्राउज़र में आप SIMY में लॉग इन नहीं हैं। पहले वेब पर लॉग इन करें (पहली बार हैं तो खाता बनाएँ), फिर ऐप में "लॉग इन" दोबारा दबाएँ।

faqPairs.question: Claude Code या Codex इस्तेमाल नहीं करते, तो भी ऐप इंस्टॉल करने का फ़ायदा है?
faqPairs.answer: मीटिंग और चैट से काम उठाने वाला फ़ीचर सिर्फ़ वेब से भी चलता है, इसलिए ऐप ज़रूरी नहीं। जो PC पर Claude Code या Codex इस्तेमाल करते हैं, उनके लिए ऐप इंस्टॉल करने पर बातचीत सुझाव बनती है, और SIMY से PC का AI चलाया जा सकता है।

faqPairs.question: क्या ChatGPT या Claude का सब्सक्रिप्शन ज़रूरी है?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY का क्लाउड में चलने वाला काम आपके ChatGPT खाते (Codex) से होता है। PC का Claude Code चलाते समय आपका अपना Claude Code लॉग इन ही इस्तेमाल होता है। Claude के टोकन को क्लाउड में चलने वाले काम से नहीं जोड़ा जा सकता। Gemini के टोकन का कनेक्शन अभी विकास में है।

faqPairs.question: क्या Intel वाले Mac पर चलता है?
faqPairs.answer: अभी का Mac ऐप Apple silicon (M1 या नया) के लिए है। Intel वाले Mac पर SIMY को वेब से इस्तेमाल करें।

faqPairs.question: डाउनलोड की गई फ़ाइल का नाम "SIMY-CLI" है।
faqPairs.answer: यह वही ऐप है। डेस्कटॉप ऐप में इंजीनियरों के लिए टर्मिनल से चलने वाला SIMY CLI भी शामिल है, इसलिए फ़ाइल के नाम में वह जुड़ा है। आम तौर पर सिर्फ़ ऐप की स्क्रीन से काम चल जाता है।

faqPairs.question: 可以免费试用吗？
faqPairs.answer: 没有免费套餐。选择月付套餐并注册后，应用和网页版都可以使用。费用请查看首页的价格栏目。

faqPairs.question: 可以先不建账号，只安装应用吗？
faqPairs.answer: 可以安装，但登录需要SIMY账号。先创建账号，再点击应用里的“登录”，是最快的顺序。

faqPairs.question: 注册需要准备什么？
faqPairs.answer: 邮箱地址和信用卡。通过收到的邮件中的链接验证身份，所以不需要设置密码。付款在银行卡支付页面完成。

faqPairs.question: 在应用里点击“登录”后，显示“Unauthorized”。
faqPairs.answer: 这是浏览器尚未登录SIMY的状态。请先在网页上登录（首次使用请创建账号），再点击一次应用里的“登录”。

faqPairs.question: 不用Claude Code或Codex，也有必要安装吗？
faqPairs.answer: 从会议和聊天中接手工作的功能，只用网页版就能使用，所以应用不是必需的。在电脑上使用Claude Code或Codex的人，安装应用后对话会变成建议，还能从SIMY驱动电脑上的AI。

faqPairs.question: 需要订阅ChatGPT或Claude吗？
faqPairs.answer: SIMY的云端执行使用你自己的ChatGPT账号（Codex）运行。驱动电脑上的Claude Code时，会直接使用你Claude Code的登录状态。Claude的令牌无法接入云端执行。Gemini的令牌接入正在开发中。

faqPairs.question: Intel芯片的Mac也能用吗？
faqPairs.answer: 目前的Mac版面向Apple芯片（M1及以后）。Intel芯片的Mac请通过网页使用SIMY。

faqPairs.question: 下载的文件名是“SIMY-CLI”。
faqPairs.answer: 是同一个应用。桌面应用里还包含面向工程师、可在终端中使用的SIMY CLI，所以文件名带有这个名称。平时只用应用界面就可以。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT に同じ指示を毎回書かないようにする方法はありますか？
faqPairs.answer: ChatGPT の中では、カスタム指示、プロジェクト、GPTs の3つが「毎回書かない」ための工夫です。ただし、どれも始めるのはあなたで、頼んだ1件の回答が返ってくるところで終わります。会議やチャットから仕事を拾い、あなたのやり方で進めて判断だけ返すのが SIMY で、ChatGPT の工夫と置き換えではなく重ねて使います。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT に入力した内容を学習に使わせない設定（学習オフ）の手順は？
faqPairs.answer: 設定を開き、「データコントロール」で「すべての人のためにモデルを改善する」をオフにします。個人向けプラン（Free・Go・Plus・Pro）では既定でオンなので、顧客名や金額を入力する前に確認してください。Business と Enterprise の業務データは、既定では学習に使われません。

faqPairs.question: 無料プランで GPTs は使えますか？作れますか？
faqPairs.answer: 無料プランでも GPT ストアにある GPTs を使うことはできますが、自分で GPTs を作成できるのは Plus 以上の有料プランです（2026年10月時点）。

faqPairs.question: 社内限定の GPTs を作るには、どのプランが必要ですか？
faqPairs.answer: ワークスペースの中だけで共有する GPTs は、Team や Business 以上の法人向けプランで作れます。個人プランで作った GPTs は、リンクを知っている人か全体への公開になります。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT の Go と Plus、どちらを選べばいいですか？
faqPairs.answer: 2026年10月3日確認：Free・GoにもデスクトップアプリでGPT-6 Lunaを標準速度で使える枠があり、順次提供中です。Plus以上とは利用環境・モデル・上限が異なります。APIキー利用は別料金です。SIMYのクラウド連携条件とは分けて確認してください。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT Work とは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: 2026年7月9日に OpenAI が公開した、長く込み入った作業のためのエージェントです。連携したアプリとファイルを横断して調査・分析し、資料、スプレッドシート、プレゼン、レポート、Sites を仕上げます。Scheduled Tasks で1回限り・繰り返し・変更の監視といった実行もできます。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT Work と Codex の違いは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: Work は調査、分析、資料やレポートの作成など仕事全般の成果物を仕上げるエージェントで、Codex はソフトウェア開発のためのエージェントです。同じ実行・権限の仕組みと利用枠を共有していて、GPT-6 Sol と Luna は Work と Codex 専用のモデルです。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT Work と SIMY の違いは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: Work は、あなたが指示した1件を最後まで仕上げる実行役です。SIMY は、会議や Slack の会話から仕事を拾い、あなたのやり方で進めて、判断だけを返す管理役です。SIMY はお使いの ChatGPT アカウントの Codex を実行役に使うので、置き換えではなく重ねて使います。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT Business は1人でも使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: Business は2ユーザー以上のチーム向けのプランで、管理コンソール、SAML／SSO、業務データが既定では学習に使われない設定が最初から含まれます。1人で使う場合は Plus か Pro が基本で、学習に使わせない設定は個人プランでも行えます。

faqPairs.question: SIMY を使うと、AI の利用料が別にかかりますか？
faqPairs.answer: SIMY はお使いの ChatGPT アカウントをつなぎ、Codex App Server 経由で仕事を進めます。Codex の利用は、お使いの ChatGPT プランの範囲で行われます。SIMY 自体の料金は料金ページをご覧ください。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT 以外の AI でも SIMY を使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: クラウドでの実行は、お使いの ChatGPT アカウント（Codex）で行います。PC 上では、SIMY のデスクトップアプリや CLI が、Codex のほかに Claude Code も実行役にできます。どちらかが不調なときや利用枠の上限に当たったときの備えになります。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT で Excel の関数やマクロ（VBA・GAS）を作れますか？
faqPairs.answer: 作れます。やりたいことを日本語で書くと数式やコードが返ってくるので、Excel や Apps Script に貼って実行します。社外秘のデータは貼らず、学習に使わせない設定も確認してください。毎回 ChatGPT に頼んでいる定型の仕事は、SIMY が会議とチャットから拾って進めます。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAI（LLM）にはどんなものがありますか？
faqPairs.answer: 主なものは、DeepSeek、AlibabaグループのQwen、Moonshot AIのKimi、ZhipuのGLM（Z.ai）、MiniMax、ByteDanceのDoubao、TencentのHy（旧Hunyuan）、BaiduのERNIEです。2026年10月時点の違いは、このページの比較カードにまとめています。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIは無料で使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: チャットは多くが無料で使えます。APIは従量課金で、オープンウェイトのモデルは自分の環境で動かせば利用料はかかりません。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIでAPIが一番安いのはどれですか？
faqPairs.answer: 2026年10月時点では、DeepSeek（V4.1-Flash）とMiniMax（M3）の単価が特に安い水準です。時間帯や入力の長さで単価が変わるため、各社の公式の料金ページで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIは日本語に対応していますか？
faqPairs.answer: 日本語を公式に明記しているのはQwen（119の言語・方言）です。ほかのモデルも日本語で使える場面は多いものの、公式の保証はないため、業務文書で試して確かめてください。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIを自分のPCで動かせますか？
faqPairs.answer: 一部は動かせます。OllamaならQwen3.8-27B（約18GB）、GLM-4.7-Flash（約19GB）、DeepSeek-R1の小型版が現実的です。各社の最新の主力は大きすぎて、個人のPC向けではありません。

faqPairs.question: Ollamaにあるモデルは、すべて手元のPCで動きますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。cloudタグのモデルはOllamaのクラウドで動き、手元のPCでは動きません。2026年10月時点で、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、MiniMax-M3はcloudタグのみです。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIをClaude CodeやCodexから使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 使えます。DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM（Z.ai）、MiniMaxなどはAnthropic互換やOpenAI互換のAPIを用意しており、接続先を差し替えて使えます。その場合、ツールが読んだコードもその会社のサーバーに送られる点に注意してください。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIに入力したデータはどこに保存されますか？
faqPairs.answer: 会社と入口によって違います。DeepSeekは中国、Kimiは中国向けアプリが中国でAPIがシンガポール、Z.ai・MiniMaxの海外向けサービスとQwen Chatはシンガポールで処理すると案内しています。データを外に出したくないなら、オープンウェイトを自社の環境で動かす方式を選びます。

faqPairs.question: 日本で中国のAIの利用は禁止されていますか？
faqPairs.answer: 一律に禁止する法律や命令は、2026年10月時点で私たちが調べた範囲では見当たりません。ただし個人情報保護委員会と政府のデジタル社会推進会議幹事会が2025年2月にDeepSeekなどについて注意喚起を出しており、リスクを踏まえて判断することが求められています。

faqPairs.question: 中国のAIは安全ですか？
faqPairs.answer: 一律に安全とも危険とも言えず、どの入口を使い、データがどの国に保存されるかで判断します。消費者向けアプリに機密は入れず、学習への利用を止める設定を確認し、データを外に出したくない場合はオープンウェイトを自社の環境で動かします。

faqPairs.question: オープンウェイトなら、商用で自由に使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: モデルによります。MITやApache 2.0のモデルは比較的自由ですが、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、MiniMax-M3は売上規模や表示義務などの条件つきの独自ライセンスです。商用で使う前にライセンス本文を確認してください。

faqPairs.question: SIMYは中国のAIで動きますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。現時点では、SIMYはこのページの中国のAIには接続せず、お使いのChatGPT（Codex）アカウントと、SIMYデスクトップアプリ経由でPC上のClaude Codeで動きます。調査や下書きは中国のAIのまま使い、決まったことの段取りをSIMYに任せる、という分け方ができます。

faqPairs.question: AIで出した答えのあとの仕事は、毎回SIMYに頼む必要がありますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。SIMYは会議の記録やチャットから、決まったことと担当・期限を自分で拾います。あなたのやり方を会話から学び、判断が必要なところだけをあなたに返します。

faqPairs.question: Claudeの読み方と、開発元はどこの会社ですか？
faqPairs.answer: 読み方は「クロード」です。開発元は米国サンフランシスコのAnthropic（アンソロピック）で、Web、デスクトップアプリ、スマートフォンアプリ、ブラウザ拡張から日本語で使えます。

faqPairs.question: Claudeの無料版では、どこまで仕事に使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 文章の作成や要約、ファイルを添えた質問、Artifactsでの資料づくりは無料版でも使えます。利用回数に上限があり、混雑時は制限が早く来ます。Claude CodeやCoworkは有料プランが必要です。

faqPairs.question: Opus・Sonnet・Haiku・Fableは、どう選べばいいですか？
faqPairs.answer: 日常の仕事はSonnet、難しい判断や長い資料の読み込みはOpus、短い定型処理を速く回したいときはHaiku、最新の総合力が必要ならFableが目安です。迷ったら既定のモデルで始め、回答に不満が出たときだけ上位に切り替えてください。

faqPairs.question: Claude Coworkとは何ですか？Claude Codeとは何が違いますか？
faqPairs.answer: Coworkは、デスクトップアプリの中でPC内のファイルやブラウザを使って仕事を任せる機能で、机の上の指示と定期タスクが得意です。Claude Codeは、ターミナルからPC上でコマンドやファイル操作を実行する実行役です。どちらも有料プランで使えます。

faqPairs.question: Claude Codeは、非エンジニアでも安全に使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 使えますが、ファイルを書き換えたり削除したりできる権限を持つため、最初は専用のフォルダで、確認を求める設定のまま使ってください。SIMYの実行役として使う場合も、外部への送信や投稿はあなたの承認が必要です。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPTとClaude、仕事で使うならどっちがいいですか？
faqPairs.answer: 長い文書を読んで書く仕事はClaude、画像生成や幅広い連携を含めて1つで済ませたいならChatGPT、という選び方が一般的です。SIMYはどちらを使っていても、回答のあとに残る仕事を同じやり方で進めます。

faqPairs.question: 入力した内容をClaudeに学習させない設定はありますか？
faqPairs.answer: あります。個人向けプランでは設定のプライバシー項目でモデル改善への利用を自分で選べ、会社で使うならTeamやEnterpriseを検討してください。SIMYは、Claude Codeの会話本文を解析中だけ使い、サーバーに保存しません。

faqPairs.question: SIMYを使うには、Claudeの有料プランが必要ですか？
faqPairs.answer: SIMYだけなら不要です。SIMYデスクトップアプリを入れると、Claude Codeの会話をSIMYに取り込み、SIMYからClaude Codeを動かせます。このときは、あなたのClaude Codeのログインとプランがそのまま使われます。できないのは、Claudeのトークン（プランの利用枠）をSIMYのクラウド実行に連携することだけです。クラウド実行はお使いのChatGPTアカウント（Codex）で動き、Geminiのトークン連携は開発中です。

faqPairs.question: Claudeが不調なときや利用上限に達したとき、仕事は止まりますか？
faqPairs.answer: 止まりません。SIMYはCodex（ChatGPT）とPC上のClaude Codeの両方を実行役にできるため、片方が使えないときはもう片方で進められます。どちらの利用量も、それぞれのプランの範囲で計上されます。

faqPairs.question: Claude CoworkとSIMYは、何が違いますか？併用できますか？
faqPairs.answer: Coworkは、あなたが机の上で指示した仕事と定期タスクをClaudeの中で進めます。SIMYは、会議やチャットで生まれた仕事を頼まれる前に拾い、あなたのやり方で進めて判断だけ返します。併用でき、Coworkで仕上げた成果物の先をSIMYが受け持ちます。

faqPairs.question: Claude Codeの会話が「SIMYからの提案」になるまで、何が送られますか？
faqPairs.answer: SIMYデスクトップアプリが、PC内のClaude CodeとCodexの会話履歴を既定で90日分読み、繰り返している手順と確認事項を抽象化してWorkFlow候補を作ります。会話本文は解析中だけ使い、サーバーには残りません。この取り込みは設定でいつでも止められます。

faqPairs.question: Claudeで作った下書きを、毎週同じ手順で共有・記録しています。自動化できますか？
faqPairs.answer: できます。SIMYが会話からその手順を学び、WorkFlowとして提案します。承認すると、次回からは会議やチャットを起点に自動で進み、Gmailは下書き保存まで、SlackやNotionへの書き込みはあなたの承認を待ちます。

faqPairs.question: OpenAI Codex は無料で使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 2026年10月3日確認：Free・GoにもデスクトップアプリでGPT-6 Lunaを標準速度で使える枠があり、順次提供中です。Plus以上とは利用環境・モデル・上限が異なります。APIキー利用は別料金です。SIMYのクラウド連携条件とは分けて確認してください。

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT Plus で、Codex はどれくらい使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: Plus・標準Businessには5時間単位の利用枠があり、週単位の制限も適用される場合があります。Proには現在5時間制限がありません。モデルや作業量によって消費が変わるため、残量とリセット時刻は使用量ダッシュボードで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: Codex の使用量はいつリセットされますか？
faqPairs.answer: リセット時刻はプランと利用枠によって異なります。Codexの使用量ダッシュボード、またはCLIの /status に表示される残量とリセット時刻を確認してください。すべての枠が初回利用から一定時間で回復するとは限りません。

faqPairs.question: Claude Code と Codex は、どちらを選べばいいですか？
faqPairs.answer: どちらか一方に決める必要はありません。Codex は ChatGPT のプラン、Claude Code は Claude のプランで動くので、片方が不調なときや枠を使い切ったときの備えとして、両方に慣れておく人が増えています。SIMY は Codex と Claude Code の両方を実行役にできます。

faqPairs.question: Codex のプランモードとは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: ファイルを変えずに、手順と影響範囲だけを先に出させるモードです。大きな作業の前に計画を確認し、合意してから実行に移せます。承認モードと組み合わせると、何をどこまで任せるかを細かく決められます。

faqPairs.question: エンジニアでなくても Codex は使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 使えます。OpenAI は、Codex ユーザーの2割超がエンジニア以外だと説明しています（2026年時点）。デスクトップアプリに日本語で頼めば、会社調査、提案資料、議事録、Gmail の下書きまで進み、コードを見る場面はほぼありません。

faqPairs.question: Codex のスケジュール機能と SIMY は何が違いますか？
faqPairs.answer: Codex のスケジュールは時刻を起点に、決めたタスクを繰り返します。SIMY は会議やチャットを起点に、そこで生まれた仕事を見つけて Codex に進めさせます。毎朝9時の定型は Codex のスケジュールで、会議のたびに変わる仕事は SIMY で、と使い分けられます。

faqPairs.question: Codex に Chrome を操作させるのは安全ですか？
faqPairs.answer: Codex はサンドボックスの中で動き、ログインやフォーム送信など外に影響する操作の前に承認を求めます。業務で使うなら、承認モードを自動にしない、専用の Chrome プロファイルを使う、学習させない設定を確認する、の3点を押さえてください。

faqPairs.question: Codex に入力した内容は AI の学習に使われますか？
faqPairs.answer: ChatGPT の設定の「データコントロール」で「すべての人のためにモデルを改善する」をオフにすると、Codex の会話も学習に使われません。Business と Enterprise は、既定で業務データが学習に使われない契約です。

faqPairs.question: SIMY を使うと、Codex の利用料は別にかかりますか？
faqPairs.answer: SIMYはお使いのChatGPTアカウントをつなぎ、Codex App Server経由で仕事を進めます。Codexの利用は、お使いのChatGPTプランの範囲で行われます。SIMY自体の料金は料金ページをご覧ください。

faqPairs.question: スマホから Codex を使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: ChatGPT の iOS・Android アプリから Codex Cloud のタスクを確認し、新しいタスクを頼めます。SIMY の iOS アプリを使うと、Codex が進めた仕事の判断待ちだけがスマホに届き、承認して返せます。

faqPairs.question: Claude Cowork の読み方は？
faqPairs.answer: 「クロード・コワーク」と読みます。Cowork は co-work（一緒に働く）から来ていて、Anthropic が提供する Claude の作業代行エージェントの名前です。

faqPairs.question: Claude Cowork は無料で使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。2026年10月1日時点の公式案内では、Cowork は有料プラン向けの機能で、Pro・Max から順次提供されています。金額は Claude 公式の料金ページで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: Claude Cowork は Windows で使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 2026年10月1日時点で、Claude 公式には Windows（arm64 を含む）向けのデスクトップアプリのダウンロードが用意されています。対応範囲や機能の差は、最新の公式ページで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: Claude Cowork はスマホで使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 公式は、Cowork を Web とモバイルにも順次提供中（モバイルはベータ）と案内しています。デスクトップで始めた仕事を、スマホから確認したり指示を足したりする使い方が想定されています。

faqPairs.question: Claude Cowork はいつから使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 2026年10月1日時点で、有料プランなら Claude デスクトップアプリから使えます。提供プランや環境は段階的に広がっているため、お使いのプランでの開始時期は公式のお知らせで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: Claude Cowork で何ができますか？
faqPairs.answer: あなたが選んだフォルダのファイルを読み書きし、表や資料を作り、専用ブラウザで調べてフォームに入力し、必要なときだけ画面を操作します。毎日・毎週・毎月のスケジュール実行と、スキル・コネクタ・プラグインで業務に合わせる調整ができます。

faqPairs.question: Claude のチャットと Cowork は統合されたのですか？
faqPairs.answer: 公式は「Claude Cowork is now just Claude」として、Cowork を Claude 本体の機能として Pro・Max から順次提供すると案内しています（2026年10月1日時点）。統合は進行中のため、メニューの位置や名称は最新の公式で確認してください。

faqPairs.question: Cowork のスケジュール実行と SIMY の Autorun は何が違いますか？
faqPairs.answer: 起点が違います。Cowork のスケジュールは、あなたが設計した仕事を決めた時刻に繰り返し、SIMY の Autorun は、会議やチャットから拾った仕事をあなたの型で進めて判断だけを返します。定期実行そのものは、どちらにもあります。

faqPairs.question: Copilot Cowork との違いは？
faqPairs.answer: Copilot Cowork は Microsoft が Copilot として提供する業務エージェントで Microsoft 365 の中の仕事に、Claude Cowork は Anthropic のエージェントで PC のフォルダや複数のツールをまたぐ仕事に向いています。どちらも起点はあなたの指示です。詳細は各社の公式案内で確認してください。

faqPairs.question: SIMY を使うには Claude の有料プランが必要ですか？
faqPairs.answer: SIMY だけなら不要です。SIMY デスクトップアプリ を入れると、Claude Code の会話を SIMY に取り込み、SIMY から Claude Code を動かせます。このときは、あなたの Claude のログインとプランがそのまま使われます。Claude のトークンを SIMY のクラウド実行に連携することはできず、クラウド実行はお使いの ChatGPT アカウント（Codex）で動きます。Gemini のトークン連携は開発中です。SIMY の料金は料金ページをご覧ください。

faqPairs.question: Claude Code と Cowork は、どちらを使えばいいですか？
faqPairs.answer: コードとリポジトリを扱うなら Claude Code、資料・表・フォルダを扱うなら Cowork です。SIMY は Claude Code の会話履歴から「SIMY からの提案」を作り、ローカルでは Claude Code を実行役にできます。

faqPairs.question: Cowork に PC のフォルダを触らせるのは安全ですか？
faqPairs.answer: Claude が触れるのは、あなたが選んだフォルダと接続したツールだけで、削除にはあなたの承認が必要です。権限設定を有効にすると、重要な操作の前に計画を示して承認を待ちます。最初は、壊れても困らないフォルダから始めてください。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekとは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: DeepSeek（ディープシーク）は、中国・杭州のDeepSeekが開発する大規模言語モデル（LLM）と、そのチャットサービスです。無料のチャット、安いAPI、重みが公開されたオープンウェイトの3つの形で使えます。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekはどこの国のAIですか？
faqPairs.answer: 中国のAIです。運営会社は杭州の法人で、プライバシーポリシーでは集めた情報を中華人民共和国内のサーバーに保存すると案内されています。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekを設立したのは誰ですか？
faqPairs.answer: 梁文鋒（リャン・ウェンフォン）氏が2023年に設立しました。報道によると、同氏は中国の投資会社High-Flyer（幻方）の共同創業者です。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekショックとは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: 2025年1月に推論モデルDeepSeek-R1が公開され、安く作られた高性能モデルとして世界で話題になった出来事です。半導体関連の株価が大きく下落し、各国の当局がデータの扱いに注意喚起する動きにもつながりました。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekは無料で使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: はい。Webのチャットとスマホアプリは無料で使えます。APIは使った分だけの従量課金です。オープンウェイトのモデルを自分の環境で動かす場合、モデルの利用料はかかりません（機材や電気代は別）。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekは日本語で使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 使えます。公式に対応言語の一覧はありませんが、日本語で質問し、日本語で答えを受け取れます。大事な文面は、固有名詞や敬語を確かめてから使ってください。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekのAPIの料金はいくらですか？
faqPairs.answer: 使った分だけ払う従量課金で、100万トークンあたりの米ドル建てです。平日のピーク時間帯はオフピークの2倍の単価になります。単価は改定が多いため、DeepSeek公式の料金ページで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekのAPIはどう使いますか？
faqPairs.answer: DeepSeekのAPIは、APIキーを発行し、使い慣れたツールの接続先とモデル名を差し替えて使います。OpenAI互換の接続先はhttps://api.deepseek.com、Anthropic互換はhttps://api.deepseek.com/anthropicで、モデル名はdeepseek-flashなどです（2026年10月時点）。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekはローカル（自分のPC）で動かせますか？
faqPairs.answer: R1の小型版などはOllamaで動かせます。最新のV4.1-FlashはOllamaではcloudタグのみで手元では動かず、自社で動かすには大規模なGPUサーバーが必要です。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekは日本で禁止されていますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。2026年10月時点で、個人の利用を禁じる法律や命令はありません。2025年2月に個人情報保護委員会が情報提供を、デジタル庁（デジタル社会推進会議幹事会）が政府機関向けの注意喚起を出し、データが中国のサーバーに保存され中国の法令が適用されることを示しています。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekに入力した内容は学習に使われますか？
faqPairs.answer: 使われる場合があります。プライバシーポリシーには訓練への利用を拒否する権利が明記されており、アプリの設定（執筆時点の表記は「Improve the model for everyone」）でオフにできます。オフにしてもデータは中国のサーバーに保存されるため、機密情報は入れないのが基本です。

faqPairs.question: SIMYはDeepSeekで動きますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。現時点では、SIMYはお使いのChatGPT（Codex）アカウントと、PC上のClaude Codeで動きます。DeepSeekで作った答えや下書きは、そのまま会議やチャットに持ち込めます。

faqPairs.question: DeepSeekで出した答えのあとの仕事は、毎回SIMYに頼む必要がありますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。SIMYは会議の記録やチャットから、決まったことと担当・期限を自分で拾います。あなたのやり方を会話から学び、判断が必要なところだけをあなたに返します。

faqPairs.question: Doubao（豆包）とは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: Doubao（豆包）は、中国のByteDance（バイトダンス）が提供するAIアシスタントと、その土台になる大規模言語モデルのシリーズです。中国では無料のチャットアプリとして広く使われ、企業向けにはクラウドのAPIとして提供されています。

faqPairs.question: Doubaoはどこの国のAIですか？
faqPairs.answer: 中国のByteDanceが開発しています。モデルは社内の研究チームSeedが作り、中国向けのAPIはクラウド事業のVolcano Engine（火山引擎）、海外向けはBytePlusから提供されています。

faqPairs.question: 豆包の読み方は？
faqPairs.answer: 中国語では「ドウバオ（dòubāo）」と読みます。豆の餡が入った蒸しパン（包子）を指す言葉で、英語表記はDoubaoです。

faqPairs.question: 日本でDoubao（豆包）のアプリは使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 豆包アプリは中国向けのサービスで、日本での提供状況は公式には確認できませんでした。海外向けには別の名前のアシスタントアプリが提供されていると報じられています。仕事で使う場合は、提供元と利用規約を確かめてからにしてください。

faqPairs.question: Doubaoは日本語に対応していますか？
faqPairs.answer: 日本語で話しかけることはできますが、日本語への対応を明記した公式の記載は確認できませんでした。日本語の品質は、実際の業務の文書で試して確かめてください。

faqPairs.question: Doubaoのモデルはオープンソースですか？
faqPairs.answer: 主力のDoubao-Seedシリーズは重みが公開されていません。一方で、Seed-OSS-36B（Apache 2.0）やSeed-Coder-8Bなど、一部のモデルはHugging Faceで公開されています。

faqPairs.question: Doubao APIはどこで使えますか？
faqPairs.answer: 中国向けにはVolcano Engineの「火山方舟」、海外向けにはBytePlusのModelArkから提供されています。料金と使えるモデルは窓口ごとに違うため、各公式ページで確認してください。

faqPairs.question: Doubao-Seed-Codeとは何ですか？
faqPairs.answer: ByteDanceのコーディング向けのDoubao-Seedモデルです。中国向けにはVolcano Engineのコーディング向け定額プランで提供されていると報じられています。2026年10月時点で、日本からの提供状況は公式に確認できませんでした。

faqPairs.question: Doubaoを会社で使っても大丈夫ですか？
faqPairs.answer: 一概には言えず、社内ルールと入口ごとのデータの行き先を確認してから判断してください。台湾の国家安全局が2025年11月に公表した検査では、豆包アプリは15項目のうち10項目で問題があるとされています。使う場合も、機密は入れないことが前提です。

faqPairs.question: SIMYはDoubaoで動きますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ、SIMYは現時点ではDoubaoには接続しません。SIMYはお使いのChatGPT（Codex）アカウントと、PC上のClaude Codeで動きます。Doubaoで作った訳文や下書きは、そのまま会議やチャットに持ち込めます。

faqPairs.question: Doubaoで出した答えのあとの仕事は、毎回SIMYに頼む必要がありますか？
faqPairs.answer: いいえ。SIMYは会議の記録やチャットから、決まったことと担当・期限を自分で拾います。あなたのやり方を会話から学び、判断が必要なところだけをあなたに返します。

faqPairs.question: Is there a way to stop typing the same instructions into ChatGPT every time?
faqPairs.answer: Inside ChatGPT, custom instructions, projects and GPTs are the three ways to avoid retyping. But you still start each one, and each ends when the answer to that one request comes back. SIMY picks up work from meetings and chats, does it your way and returns only decisions. You use it on top of those ChatGPT features, not instead of them.

faqPairs.question: How do I stop ChatGPT from training on what I type?
faqPairs.answer: Open Settings, go to Data Controls, and turn off "Improve the model for everyone." It is on by default on personal plans (Free, Go, Plus and Pro), so check it before entering client names or amounts. Business and Enterprise data is not used for training by default.

faqPairs.question: Can I use or build GPTs on the free plan?
faqPairs.answer: On the free plan you can use GPTs from the GPT Store, but building your own GPTs requires a paid plan, Plus or above (as of October 2026).

faqPairs.question: Which plan do I need to build GPTs shared only inside my company?
faqPairs.answer: GPTs shared only within a workspace can be built on business plans such as Team or Business and above. GPTs built on personal plans can be shared only with people who have the link or with everyone.

faqPairs.question: Should I choose ChatGPT Go or Plus?
faqPairs.answer: Checked October 3, 2026: Free and Go offer GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app, subject to rollout. Available surfaces, models and limits differ from Plus and higher plans. API-key usage is billed separately. Check SIMY cloud connection requirements separately.

faqPairs.question: What is ChatGPT Work?
faqPairs.answer: An agent for long, complex tasks, released by OpenAI on July 9, 2026. It researches and analyzes across your connected apps and files, then finishes documents, spreadsheets, presentations, reports and Sites. With Scheduled Tasks it can also run once, on a repeating schedule, or when something changes.

faqPairs.question: What is the difference between ChatGPT Work and Codex?
faqPairs.answer: Work is an agent that finishes general work output such as research, analysis, documents and reports. Codex is an agent for software development. They share the same execution and permission model and the same usage limits, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna are models exclusive to Work and Codex.

faqPairs.question: What is the difference between ChatGPT Work and SIMY?
faqPairs.answer: Work is a doer that finishes the one task you assign. SIMY is a manager that picks up work from meetings and Slack conversations, does it your way and returns only decisions. SIMY uses Codex in your own ChatGPT account as its doer, so you use them together, not one instead of the other.

faqPairs.question: Can I use ChatGPT Business on my own?
faqPairs.answer: Business is a plan for teams with at least two users, and includes an admin console, SAML/SSO, and business data excluded from training by default. On your own, Plus or Pro is the usual choice, and you can turn off training on personal plans too.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY add separate AI usage fees?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY connects to your own ChatGPT account and does the work through the Codex App Server. Codex usage falls within your ChatGPT plan. For SIMY's own pricing, see the pricing page.

faqPairs.question: Can I use SIMY with AI other than ChatGPT?
faqPairs.answer: Cloud runs use your own ChatGPT account (Codex). On your computer, the SIMY desktop app and CLI can use Claude Code as well as Codex to do the work. That gives you a backup when one is down or hits its usage limit.

faqPairs.question: Can ChatGPT write Excel formulas or macros (VBA or Apps Script)?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Describe what you want in plain English and it returns a formula or code to paste into Excel or Apps Script. Don't paste confidential data, and check your training setting. For routine work you ask ChatGPT for every time, SIMY picks it up from meetings and chats and moves it forward.

faqPairs.question: What Chinese AI models (LLMs) are there?
faqPairs.answer: The main ones are DeepSeek, Alibaba Group's Qwen, Moonshot AI's Kimi, Zhipu's GLM (Z.ai), MiniMax, ByteDance's Doubao, Tencent's Hy (formerly Hunyuan) and Baidu's ERNIE. The comparison cards on this page sum up how they differ as of October 2026.

faqPairs.question: Can I use Chinese AI for free?
faqPairs.answer: Most of the chat apps are free. APIs are pay-as-you-go, and open-weight models cost nothing to use if you run them in your own environment.

faqPairs.question: Which Chinese AI has the cheapest API?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 2026, DeepSeek (V4.1-Flash) and MiniMax (M3) are especially cheap per token. Rates vary by time of day and input length, so check each company's official pricing page.

faqPairs.question: Do Chinese AI models support languages other than English and Chinese?
faqPairs.answer: Qwen is the one that officially lists broad language support (119 languages and dialects). Other models often work in other languages too, but there's no official guarantee, so test them on your own work documents.

faqPairs.question: Can I run Chinese AI models on my own computer?
faqPairs.answer: Some of them. With Ollama, Qwen3.8-27B (about 18 GB), GLM-4.7-Flash (about 19 GB) and small DeepSeek-R1 versions are realistic. Each company's latest flagship is too large for a personal computer.

faqPairs.question: Does every model in Ollama run on my own computer?
faqPairs.answer: No. Models with the cloud tag run on Ollama's cloud, not on your computer. As of October 2026, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3 and MiniMax-M3 are cloud-tag only.

faqPairs.question: Can I use Chinese AI from Claude Code or Codex?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM (Z.ai), MiniMax and others offer Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible APIs, so you can switch the endpoint and use them. Note that the code your tool reads is then sent to that company's servers too.

faqPairs.question: Where is the data I enter into Chinese AI stored?
faqPairs.answer: It depends on the company and the entry point. DeepSeek says China; Kimi says China for its China-facing app and Singapore for its API; the international services of Z.ai and MiniMax, and Qwen Chat, say Singapore. If you don't want data to leave your hands, run an open-weight model in your own environment.

faqPairs.question: Is using Chinese AI banned in Japan?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 2026, we found no law or order that bans it outright. However, in February 2025 Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission and the executive committee of the government's Digital Society Promotion Council issued warnings about DeepSeek and similar services, asking for decisions based on the risks.

faqPairs.question: Is Chinese AI safe?
faqPairs.answer: It isn't simply safe or unsafe; judge it by which entry point you use and which country stores your data. Keep confidential information out of consumer apps, check the setting that stops your data being used for training, and run open weights in your own environment if data must not leave it.

faqPairs.question: Can I use open-weight models freely for commercial work?
faqPairs.answer: It depends on the model. MIT and Apache 2.0 models are relatively free to use, but Kimi K3, GLM-5.3 and MiniMax-M3 have custom licenses with conditions such as revenue size or attribution requirements. Read the license text before commercial use.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on Chinese AI?
faqPairs.answer: No. At this time, SIMY does not connect to the Chinese AI models on this page. It runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and, through the SIMY desktop app, on Claude Code on your computer. You can keep using Chinese AI for research and drafts, and leave the follow-through on decisions to SIMY.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time to handle the work after an AI answer?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from your meeting records and chats on its own. It learns your way of working from your conversations and returns only what needs your decision.

faqPairs.question: Who makes Claude, and where can I use it?
faqPairs.answer: Claude is made by Anthropic, based in San Francisco. You can use it on the web, in desktop and mobile apps, and through a browser extension.

faqPairs.question: How much work can I do on Claude's free plan?
faqPairs.answer: Writing, summarizing, asking about attached files and building documents with Artifacts all work on the free plan. Usage is capped, and limits come sooner at busy times. Claude Code and Cowork need a paid plan.

faqPairs.question: How do I choose between Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and Fable?
faqPairs.answer: As a rule of thumb: Sonnet for daily work, Opus for hard judgment calls and long documents, Haiku for fast short routine tasks, and Fable when you need the latest all-round strength. If unsure, start with the default and move up only when the answers fall short.

faqPairs.question: What is Claude Cowork, and how is it different from Claude Code?
faqPairs.answer: Cowork lets you hand off work inside the desktop app using your local files and a browser, and it's good at desk tasks and scheduled tasks. Claude Code works from the terminal, running commands and editing files on your computer. Both need a paid plan.

faqPairs.question: Is Claude Code safe for non-engineers?
faqPairs.answer: Yes, but it can edit and delete files, so start in a dedicated folder with confirmations turned on. When it runs work for SIMY, anything sent or posted outside still needs your approval.

faqPairs.question: ChatGPT or Claude: which is better for work?
faqPairs.answer: A common split is Claude for reading and writing long documents, and ChatGPT if you want image generation and broad integrations in one tool. Whichever you use, SIMY handles the work left after the answer the same way.

faqPairs.question: Can I stop Claude from training on what I enter?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. On personal plans you choose in the privacy settings whether your data helps improve models; for company use, consider Team or Enterprise. SIMY uses Claude Code chat text only during analysis and does not store it on its servers.

faqPairs.question: Do I need a paid Claude plan to use SIMY?
faqPairs.answer: Not for SIMY itself. With the SIMY desktop app, you can bring your Claude Code chats into SIMY and run Claude Code from SIMY. That uses your existing Claude Code login and plan. The only thing you can't do is use your Claude tokens (your plan's usage) for SIMY's cloud runs. Cloud runs use your ChatGPT account (Codex), and Gemini token support is in development.

faqPairs.question: Does my work stop when Claude is down or I hit the usage limit?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY can run work with both Codex (ChatGPT) and Claude Code on your computer, so when one isn't available it continues with the other. Usage on each counts against its own plan.

faqPairs.question: How is Claude Cowork different from SIMY? Can I use both?
faqPairs.answer: Cowork runs the work you assign at your desk, plus scheduled tasks, inside Claude. SIMY picks up work born in meetings and chat before you ask, does it your way, and returns only decisions. You can use both, and SIMY takes over from what Cowork finishes.

faqPairs.question: What gets sent before my Claude Code chats become "Suggestions from SIMY"?
faqPairs.answer: The SIMY desktop app reads 90 days of Claude Code and Codex chat history on your computer by default, then abstracts the steps and checks you repeat into WorkFlow candidates. Chat text is used only during analysis and is not kept on our servers. You can turn this off in settings at any time.

faqPairs.question: I share and log Claude drafts the same way every week. Can that be automated?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. SIMY learns that routine from your conversations and suggests it as a WorkFlow. Once approved, it runs automatically from meetings and chat; Gmail stops at drafts, and Slack or Notion writes wait for your approval.

faqPairs.question: Is OpenAI Codex free?
faqPairs.answer: Checked October 3, 2026: Free and Go offer GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app, subject to rollout. Available surfaces, models and limits differ from Plus and higher plans. API-key usage is billed separately. Check SIMY cloud connection requirements separately.

faqPairs.question: How much Codex do I get with ChatGPT Plus?
faqPairs.answer: Plus and Standard Business have five-hour allowances; weekly limits may also apply. Pro currently has no five-hour limit. Consumption depends on the model and task, so check the usage dashboard for your remaining allowance and reset times.

faqPairs.question: When does Codex usage reset?
faqPairs.answer: Reset times depend on your plan and allowance. Check the remaining usage and reset times in the Codex usage dashboard or /status in the CLI. Do not assume every allowance resets a fixed time after first use.

faqPairs.question: Claude Code or Codex: which should I choose?
faqPairs.answer: You don't have to pick one. Codex runs on a ChatGPT plan and Claude Code on a Claude plan, so more people learn both as a backup when one has issues or runs out. SIMY can run work with both Codex and Claude Code.

faqPairs.question: What is Codex plan mode?
faqPairs.answer: A mode that lays out the steps and scope first, without changing any files. You can review the plan before big work and run it once you agree. Combined with approval modes, you can set exactly how much to delegate.

faqPairs.question: Can non-engineers use Codex?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. OpenAI says more than 20% of Codex users are not engineers (as of 2026). Ask the desktop app in plain language and it handles company research, proposal decks, meeting notes and Gmail drafts, with almost no code in sight.

faqPairs.question: How are Codex schedules different from SIMY?
faqPairs.answer: Codex schedules start from the clock and repeat a set task. SIMY starts from meetings and chat, finds the work they create, and has Codex do it. Use Codex schedules for the 9 a.m. routine and SIMY for work that changes with every meeting.

faqPairs.question: Is it safe to let Codex control Chrome?
faqPairs.answer: Codex runs in a sandbox and asks for approval before actions with outside effects, like logging in or submitting forms. For work use, keep three things in place: don't set approvals to auto, use a dedicated Chrome profile, and check your training opt-out setting.

faqPairs.question: Is what I enter in Codex used to train AI?
faqPairs.answer: If you turn off "Improve the model for everyone" under Data controls in ChatGPT settings, your Codex chats aren't used for training either. On Business and Enterprise, work data isn't used for training by default under the contract.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY charge extra for Codex usage?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY connects your ChatGPT account and gets work done through the Codex App Server. Codex usage comes out of your own ChatGPT plan. For SIMY's own pricing, see the pricing page.

faqPairs.question: Can I use Codex from my phone?
faqPairs.answer: From the ChatGPT iOS and Android apps, you can check Codex Cloud tasks and start new ones. With SIMY's iOS app, only the pending decisions from work Codex has done reach your phone, and you can approve them there.

faqPairs.question: What does the name Claude Cowork mean?
faqPairs.answer: Cowork comes from "co-work," working together. It's the name of Anthropic's Claude agent that does work on your behalf.

faqPairs.question: Is Claude Cowork free?
faqPairs.answer: No. As of October 1, 2026, official guidance says Cowork is a paid-plan feature rolling out from Pro and Max. Check Claude's official pricing page for prices.

faqPairs.question: Does Claude Cowork work on Windows?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 1, 2026, Claude offers official desktop app downloads for Windows (including arm64). Check the latest official page for coverage and feature differences.

faqPairs.question: Can I use Claude Cowork on my phone?
faqPairs.answer: Anthropic says Cowork is rolling out to web and mobile too (mobile in beta). The expected use is checking on work started on the desktop and adding instructions from your phone.

faqPairs.question: When can I start using Claude Cowork?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 1, 2026, paid plans can use it from the Claude desktop app. Plans and platforms are expanding in stages, so check official announcements for when it reaches your plan.

faqPairs.question: What can Claude Cowork do?
faqPairs.answer: It reads and writes files in folders you choose, creates spreadsheets and documents, researches and fills in forms in a dedicated browser, and controls the screen only when needed. It can run on daily, weekly or monthly schedules, and you can tailor it to your work with skills, connectors and plugins.

faqPairs.question: Have Claude chat and Cowork been merged?
faqPairs.answer: Anthropic says "Claude Cowork is now just Claude," rolling Cowork out as part of Claude itself starting with Pro and Max (as of October 1, 2026). The merge is in progress, so check the latest official guidance for menu locations and names.

faqPairs.question: How are Cowork's scheduled runs different from SIMY's Autorun?
faqPairs.answer: The starting point differs. Cowork schedules repeat work you designed at a set time; SIMY's Autorun takes work picked up from meetings and chat, does it your way, and returns only decisions. Both have scheduled runs.

faqPairs.question: How is it different from Copilot Cowork?
faqPairs.answer: Copilot Cowork is Microsoft's work agent in Copilot, suited to work inside Microsoft 365. Claude Cowork is Anthropic's agent, suited to work across local folders and many tools. Both start from your instructions. Check each company's official guidance for details.

faqPairs.question: Do I need a paid Claude plan to use SIMY?
faqPairs.answer: Not for SIMY itself. With the SIMY desktop app, you can bring your Claude Code chats into SIMY and run Claude Code from SIMY. That uses your existing Claude login and plan. Claude tokens can't be used for SIMY's cloud runs; cloud runs use your ChatGPT account (Codex). Gemini token support is in development. For SIMY pricing, see the pricing page.

faqPairs.question: Claude Code or Cowork: which should I use?
faqPairs.answer: Claude Code for code and repositories; Cowork for documents, spreadsheets and folders. SIMY creates "Suggestions from SIMY" from your Claude Code chat history and can use Claude Code to do the work locally.

faqPairs.question: Is it safe to let Cowork touch folders on my computer?
faqPairs.answer: Claude can touch only the folders you choose and the tools you connect, and deleting anything needs your approval. With permission settings on, it shows its plan before important actions and waits for approval. Start with a folder you can afford to mess up.

faqPairs.question: What is DeepSeek?
faqPairs.answer: DeepSeek is a family of large language models (LLMs) and a chat service built by DeepSeek in Hangzhou, China. You can use it three ways: free chat, a low-cost API, and open-weight models whose weights are public.

faqPairs.question: Which country is DeepSeek from?
faqPairs.answer: China. The operator is a company based in Hangzhou, and its privacy policy says collected information is stored on servers in the People's Republic of China.

faqPairs.question: Who founded DeepSeek?
faqPairs.answer: Liang Wenfeng founded it in 2023. According to reports, he is a co-founder of the Chinese investment firm High-Flyer.

faqPairs.question: What was the DeepSeek shock?
faqPairs.answer: It was the worldwide stir after the reasoning model DeepSeek-R1 was released in January 2025 as a cheaply built, high-performing model. Chip-related stocks fell sharply, and authorities in several countries began issuing warnings about how it handles data.

faqPairs.question: Is DeepSeek free?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. The web chat and mobile app are free. The API is pay-as-you-go. If you run the open-weight models on your own hardware, there is no fee for the model (hardware and electricity are separate).

faqPairs.question: Does DeepSeek work in languages other than English?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. There is no official list of supported languages, but you can ask questions and get answers in other languages, such as Japanese. For important text, check names and formal wording before using it.

faqPairs.question: How much does the DeepSeek API cost?
faqPairs.answer: It is pay-as-you-go, priced in US dollars per million tokens. Weekday peak hours cost twice the off-peak rate. Rates change often, so check the official DeepSeek pricing page.

faqPairs.question: How do I use the DeepSeek API?
faqPairs.answer: Create an API key, then swap the endpoint and model name in the tools you already use. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint is https://api.deepseek.com, the Anthropic-compatible one is https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic, and model names include deepseek-flash (as of October 2026).

faqPairs.question: Can I run DeepSeek locally on my own PC?
faqPairs.answer: Small versions of R1 and similar models run in Ollama. The latest V4.1-Flash has only cloud tags in Ollama and does not run locally, and running it in-house requires large GPU servers.

faqPairs.question: Is DeepSeek banned in Japan?
faqPairs.answer: No. As of October 2026, no law or order bars individuals from using it. In February 2025, Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission published information on DeepSeek, and Japan's Digital Agency (the secretariat of the Digital Society Promotion Council) issued a caution to government agencies, noting that data is stored on servers in China and is subject to Chinese law.

faqPairs.question: Is what I enter into DeepSeek used for training?
faqPairs.answer: It can be. The privacy policy states your right to refuse use for training, and you can turn it off in the app settings (labeled "Improve the model for everyone" at the time of writing). Even with it off, data is stored on servers in China, so as a rule, keep confidential information out.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on DeepSeek?
faqPairs.answer: No. At this time, SIMY runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and Claude Code on your PC. You can bring answers and drafts you made in DeepSeek straight into your meetings and chat.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time to handle the work after a DeepSeek answer?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from your meeting notes and chat on its own. It learns your way of working from your conversations and returns only the parts that need your decision.

faqPairs.question: What is Doubao (豆包)?
faqPairs.answer: Doubao (豆包) is an AI assistant from ByteDance in China, and the name of the large language model series behind it. In China it's widely used as a free chat app, and businesses can use it as a cloud API.

faqPairs.question: Which country is Doubao from?
faqPairs.answer: It's developed by ByteDance in China. The models are built by ByteDance's in-house research team, Seed. The API is offered through the cloud business Volcano Engine (火山引擎) in China and through BytePlus internationally.

faqPairs.question: How do you pronounce Doubao?
faqPairs.answer: In Chinese it's dòubāo, roughly "doe-bao". The word refers to a steamed bun (baozi) filled with sweet bean paste, and it's written Doubao in English.

faqPairs.question: Can I use the Doubao app outside China?
faqPairs.answer: The Doubao app is a service for China, and we couldn't find official information on its availability in other countries such as Japan. International users are reportedly offered an assistant app under a different name. Before using it for work, check who provides it and read the terms of service.

faqPairs.question: Does Doubao work in languages other than Chinese?
faqPairs.answer: You can talk to it in other languages, but we couldn't find official documentation stating support for them (we checked for Japanese). Test the quality with real documents from your own work.

faqPairs.question: Are Doubao's models open source?
faqPairs.answer: The weights of the flagship Doubao-Seed series are not published. Some models are on Hugging Face, though, including Seed-OSS-36B (Apache 2.0) and Seed-Coder-8B.

faqPairs.question: Where can I use the Doubao API?
faqPairs.answer: It's offered through Volcano Engine's Ark (火山方舟) in China and through BytePlus ModelArk internationally. Pricing and available models differ by provider, so check each official page.

faqPairs.question: What is Doubao-Seed-Code?
faqPairs.answer: It's ByteDance's Doubao-Seed model for coding. It's reportedly offered in China through a flat-rate coding plan on Volcano Engine. As of October 2026, we couldn't officially confirm its availability outside China, such as in Japan.

faqPairs.question: Is it safe to use Doubao at work?
faqPairs.answer: There's no one answer; check your company's rules and where data goes for each entry point before deciding. In tests published by Taiwan's National Security Bureau in November 2025, the Doubao app was found to have problems on 10 of 15 indicators. Even if you use it, keep confidential information out.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on Doubao?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY doesn't connect to Doubao at this time. SIMY runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and Claude Code on your computer. You can bring translations and drafts made with Doubao straight into your meetings and chats.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time for the work after Doubao answers?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from meeting records and chats on its own. It learns your way of working from conversations and returns only the points that need your decision.

faqPairs.question: What is GLM?
faqPairs.answer: GLM is a series of large language models (LLMs) developed by Zhipu AI in China. Internationally, it offers chat, an API and a flat-rate plan for coding under the Z.ai name. In statistics, GLM also stands for "generalized linear model", which is unrelated.

faqPairs.question: Which country is GLM (Z.ai) from?
faqPairs.answer: The developer, Zhipu AI, is based in Beijing, China. The international Z.ai service is run by a Singapore company, and its privacy policy says personal data is, in principle, processed in Singapore.

faqPairs.question: What is the latest GLM model?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 2026, the flagships are GLM-5.3 and the lighter, faster GLM-5.3-Flash. Model names change every few months, so check the official list.

faqPairs.question: Can I still use GLM-5.2?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. As of October 2026, Z.ai's API price list shows GLM-5.2 at the same rates as GLM-5.3. On the GLM Coding Plan, requests for GLM-5.2 are redirected to GLM-5.3.

faqPairs.question: What is the GLM Coding Plan?
faqPairs.answer: It's a monthly flat-rate plan for using GLM from coding tools such as Claude Code, Cline and OpenCode. As of October 2026, the official page lists the smallest tier, Lite, at $18 a month. Check the official page for Pro and Max pricing.

faqPairs.question: Can I use GLM in Claude Code?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Z.ai offers an Anthropic-compatible API, so you can call GLM from Claude Code by swapping its endpoint and API key through environment variables. The steps are in Z.ai's official docs.

faqPairs.question: Is GLM free to use?
faqPairs.answer: You can try it in the web chat at chat.z.ai. On the API, the official pricing page lists GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash as free as of October 2026. Flagship models such as GLM-5.3 are pay-as-you-go.

faqPairs.question: Can I run GLM locally on my own computer?
faqPairs.answer: Some models, yes. GLM-4.7-Flash in Ollama is about 19 GB quantized and runs on a computer with plenty of memory. GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash only have cloud tags in Ollama and don't run on your own machine.

faqPairs.question: Can GLM be used commercially under its license?
faqPairs.answer: GLM-5.3-Flash is MIT licensed. GLM-5.3 uses its own license, which is largely permissive, but API providers with very large revenue must pass a review before commercial use. Read each model's license text before using it for work.

faqPairs.question: What languages does GLM support?
faqPairs.answer: You can ask in many languages and it answers in kind, but the official model cards list only English and Chinese. Test important text with real work documents before relying on it.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on GLM?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY doesn't connect to GLM (Z.ai) at this time. SIMY runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and Claude Code on your computer. You can bring code and drafts written with GLM straight into your meetings and chats.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time for the work after GLM?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from meeting records and chats on its own. It learns your way of working from conversations and returns only the points that need your decision.

faqPairs.question: What is Kimi?
faqPairs.answer: Kimi is a chat AI and a series of large language models (LLMs) built by Moonshot AI in China. You can use it three ways: chat on kimi.com or the app, the API, or the published model weights.

faqPairs.question: Which country is Kimi from?
faqPairs.answer: China. It is built by Moonshot AI in Beijing. Kimi for China is run by the Beijing entity, and the international API is provided by MOONSHOT AI PTE. LTD., a Singapore entity.

faqPairs.question: What is Kimi K3?
faqPairs.answer: Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's latest generation of models, released in July 2026 (as of October 2026). It handles a 1M-token context, accepts images and video as well as text, and its weights are published under the custom Kimi K3 License.

faqPairs.question: How is Kimi K3 different from Kimi K2?
faqPairs.answer: K3 is the latest flagship, with long context and image and video input, published under the custom Kimi K3 License. The K2 series is the previous generation, and the coding model k2.7-code is priced lower than K3 on the API.

faqPairs.question: Is Kimi free?
faqPairs.answer: Chat on kimi.com and the app is free to start. Paid memberships raise your limits, and the API is pay-as-you-go.

faqPairs.question: What is Kimi Code?
faqPairs.answer: It is a coding agent that runs in the terminal, published by Moonshot AI under the MIT license. You log in with a Kimi Code account or an API key, and members can use it within their plan's allowance.

faqPairs.question: Can I use Kimi's models from Claude Code?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Kimi's API has an Anthropic-compatible endpoint, and the official docs explain how to swap Claude Code's endpoint and API key.

faqPairs.question: Can I run Kimi locally on my own PC?
faqPairs.answer: Running the latest Kimi K3 on a personal PC isn't realistic. Kimi in Ollama's official library carries the cloud tag and runs in Ollama's cloud. To run it in-house, operate the published weights on high-end GPU servers.

faqPairs.question: Where is what I enter into Kimi stored?
faqPairs.answer: According to the official explanations, Kimi chat (per the help in Chinese) stores data on servers in China, and the international API stores data on servers in Singapore. If you handle confidential information, check your internal rules and the full text of each policy.

faqPairs.question: Does Kimi work in English?
faqPairs.answer: You can ask in English and get answers in English. However, the official model card doesn't list supported languages, so check the quality on your work documents before relying on it.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on Kimi?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY does not connect to Kimi at this time; it runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and on Claude Code on your PC. You can bring the key points and code you made with Kimi straight into your meetings and chats.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time for the work after Kimi?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from your meeting records and chats on its own. It learns your way of working from your conversations and returns only what needs your decision.

faqPairs.question: So which AI meeting notes tool is best?
faqPairs.answer: It depends on your company's setup. Microsoft only: Copilot in Teams. Google only: Gemini in Meet. Free to choose: Notion AI Meeting Notes. Recording bots allowed: Notta or tl;dv. Mostly in person: PLAUD. Choose by where the summary lands rather than by summary accuracy, and the work after it stays connected.

faqPairs.question: Can I record without a bot joining the meeting?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Copilot in Teams and Gemini in Meet are built into the meeting tools, so no bot joins as a participant. Notion AI Meeting Notes records from your own device's audio, and PLAUD records on its device. Notta and tl;dv send a bot that joins as a participant.

faqPairs.question: My notes come out in the wrong language. Can I change it?
faqPairs.answer: Most tools let you set the transcription or output language. If notes come out in a different language from the meeting, the meeting or summary language setting is usually wrong, so check each tool's settings. Whatever language the record is in, SIMY prepares the follow-up work in the language and format you usually use.

faqPairs.question: I want to keep it free. What should I use?
faqPairs.answer: Record with your phone's voice memo app and give the audio to Google AI Studio for a transcript and summary, at no extra cost. Notta and tl;dv also have free plans, with a monthly cap on transcription time. Even with a free setup, you can hand the work after the summary to SIMY.

faqPairs.question: Do I need a device like PLAUD?
faqPairs.answer: Not if your meetings are mostly online; the meeting tool's features or Notion AI are enough. If you have many in-person sales calls, interviews or meeting-room sessions, PLAUD, which records just by sitting on the table, is a good fit. SIMY works the same with either kind of record.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to specify my notes format (attendees, agenda, decisions, next steps) every time?
faqPairs.answer: No. Finish one set of notes your way, and SIMY learns it and prepares the same format from the next meeting on. No more pasting transcripts into a chat AI and retyping the same instructions.

faqPairs.question: Who decides what was agreed, the AI or me?
faqPairs.answer: You do. SIMY sorts out candidate decisions and owners from the transcript and summary and takes them as far as a draft, then hands back only what needs your judgment, such as moving a deadline or whether to send.

faqPairs.question: How do I get meeting content into SIMY?
faqPairs.answer: For PLAUD, just click "Connect" on the SIMY integrations screen. Notion AI notes come through the Notion integration, and Google Docs created by Gemini in Meet come through the Google integration. If you handle meeting notes in Claude Code or Codex, SIMY finds candidate tasks in that conversation history. Check the integrations page for current support.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY add separate AI usage fees?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY connects to your own ChatGPT account and does the work with Codex. Codex usage falls within your ChatGPT plan. For SIMY's own pricing, see the pricing page.

faqPairs.question: Can I use it for confidential meetings? Do I need consent to record?
faqPairs.answer: Before recording or transcribing, get consent from every participant and check your company's rules. For confidential meetings, use only tools approved by your IT department, and check each tool's setting for using data in AI training. How SIMY handles data is published on our Security and Privacy Policy pages.

faqPairs.question: What is MiniMax?
faqPairs.answer: MiniMax is an AI company based in Shanghai, China. It builds models and apps including MiniMax H3 for video generation, MiniMax-M3 for text, and MiniMax Audio for speech synthesis.

faqPairs.question: Which country is MiniMax from?
faqPairs.answer: It is developed by a company in Shanghai, China. Its international apps are provided by Nanonoble Pte. Ltd., a company registered in Singapore.

faqPairs.question: What is MiniMax H3?
faqPairs.answer: MiniMax H3 is a generative model for video with sound, announced by MiniMax in late July 2026. It creates videos up to 15 seconds long from text, images, video and audio, and is available in Hailuo and through the API. It is a separate model from MiniMax-M3, which handles text.

faqPairs.question: Can I run MiniMax H3 locally?
faqPairs.answer: Expect it to be hard on a personal computer. The weights are published on Hugging Face, but the official instructions use a four-GPU setup as the example. To try it easily, Hailuo or the API is the realistic route.

faqPairs.question: Is MiniMax free to use?
faqPairs.answer: It varies by app, so check each app's official information for what's free. The API is paid, either pay-as-you-go or a monthly Token Plan.

faqPairs.question: How much does the MiniMax Token Plan cost?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 2026 there are three tiers: Plus at $22 a month, Max at $55 and Ultra at $132. Each has usage limits per five hours and per week.

faqPairs.question: What is MiniMax Audio?
faqPairs.answer: MiniMax Audio is MiniMax's speech synthesis app and model, turning text into natural-sounding speech. It works well for training video narration or product voiceovers.

faqPairs.question: Can I use MiniMax models from Claude Code?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. MiniMax recommends an Anthropic-compatible API format, so you can call MiniMax-M3 from Claude Code and similar tools by swapping in MiniMax's endpoint and API key.

faqPairs.question: Can I run MiniMax on my own computer?
faqPairs.answer: Running the current MiniMax-M3 on a personal computer isn't realistic. In Ollama's official library, M3 carries the cloud tag (it runs in Ollama's cloud), and the official self-hosting guide assumes several high-end GPUs.

faqPairs.question: Can MiniMax models be used commercially?
faqPairs.answer: Yes, with conditions. Commercial use of MiniMax-M3 requires a "Built with MiniMax M3" notice and notifying MiniMax, and companies with annual revenue above $20 million need written permission first. The MiniMax H3 license excludes the EU, the UK, South Korea and the US from its territory, so check where you'll use it.

faqPairs.question: Where is the data I enter into MiniMax stored?
faqPairs.answer: The policy for the international apps says data is, in principle, not transferred outside Singapore. The API has a separate policy, so read it before you sign up.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on MiniMax?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY doesn't connect to MiniMax at this time; it runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and Claude Code on your computer. You can bring scripts and assets made with MiniMax straight into your meetings and chats.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time for the work after MiniMax?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from meeting records and chats on its own. It learns your way of working from conversations and returns only the points that need your decision.

faqPairs.question: How much does Notta cost? What can I do for free?
faqPairs.answer: As of October 2026, Notta's US pricing lists Pro at $13.61 a month billed monthly ($8.17 a month billed annually, $97.99 a year) and Business at $27.34 a month billed monthly ($16.67 a month billed annually, $199.99 a year). The Free plan includes 120 minutes of transcription a month, but each conversation is capped at 3 minutes and transcripts can't be downloaded. Check https://www.notta.ai/en/pricing for your region and taxes.

faqPairs.question: Is Notta safe? Which country is it from?
faqPairs.answer: Notta is run by Notta Inc., a Japanese company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. It holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II and says data is stored in Japan. On the other hand, Section 10(4) of its terms of use states that, depending on your plan, your audio data may be used by partner companies to train speech recognition. In the pricing table, "no AI training" comes with the Enterprise plan.

faqPairs.question: What is Notta Memo?
faqPairs.answer: It's an AI voice recorder sold by Notta. It supports call recording and offline recording. There is also a higher-end Notta Memo Pro. Check Notta's official site for current prices.

faqPairs.question: What's the difference between Notta and PLAUD?
faqPairs.answer: Notta centers on recording online meetings with a bot or the desktop app, while PLAUD centers on recording in-person conversations with a dedicated voice recorder. Notta also has Notta Memo, and PLAUD has Plaud Desktop for recording meetings without a bot, so the difference is where each is strongest. SIMY can connect to your Plaud account, while with Notta you hand over transcript files.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY integrate with Notta?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY has no dedicated Notta integration (connector). Download the transcript from Notta as TXT or Word and give it to SIMY's chat, or on the Free plan, copy the transcript and paste it in. You can also hand over the audio as an MP3 and SIMY will transcribe it itself.

faqPairs.question: Can I use SIMY with Notta's Free plan?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. The Free plan can't download transcripts, so copy the transcript in Notta and paste it into SIMY's chat. Note that the Free plan caps each recording at 3 minutes, so to keep whole meetings, Pro or higher is the realistic choice.

faqPairs.question: I don't want a bot in my meetings. What can I do?
faqPairs.answer: Notta's desktop app (Windows and macOS) records your PC's audio, so no bot appears in the participant list, and it's included at no extra cost on Pro and up. There's also a privacy mode that transcribes on your PC, but as of October 2026 it's in beta and AI summaries aren't available. Even when no bot is visible, tell participants you're recording and get their consent.

faqPairs.question: Which format should I export Notta transcripts in?
faqPairs.answer: Choose TXT or Word. SIMY can't read SRT subtitle files. If you hand over audio or video (such as MP3 or MP4), SIMY transcribes it again.

faqPairs.question: Notta can write follow-up emails too. How is SIMY different?
faqPairs.answer: Notta can produce follow-up emails and CRM update data from templates, and offers sync to Salesforce and HubSpot (Business and up, according to the pricing table). SIMY connects the meeting you hand over with the emails and threads around it, carries it through to Gmail drafts and, once you approve, Slack posts and Notion updates, and returns only what needs a decision in My Actions. SIMY's job is to follow the deal until it's done, not stop at one meeting's output.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY add separate AI usage costs?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY's cloud runs use Codex on your ChatGPT account, and Codex usage falls within your ChatGPT plan. For SIMY's own pricing, see the pricing page. Your Notta costs stay as they are on your current Notta plan.

faqPairs.question: I just bought a PLAUD. Where do I start?
faqPairs.answer: Pair the device in the PLAUD app, then check your recording mode and summary template. After that, connect your Plaud account on the SIMY integrations screen and it works from your very first meeting.

faqPairs.question: I already use PLAUD. Can SIMY use my past recordings?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Once connected, SIMY searches and references the recordings, transcripts and summaries stored in your Plaud account.

faqPairs.question: Does it work with every model, including PLAUD NOTE Pro and NotePin?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. SIMY reads the transcripts and summaries saved in your Plaud account, so the model makes no difference. If you also want to record phone calls, choose PLAUD NOTE or PLAUD NOTE Pro, which have a call mode.

faqPairs.question: Can I connect on any PLAUD plan, from the free Starter to Unlimited?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. All you need is a Plaud account with a registered device. Plans differ only in transcription time: Starter gives 300 minutes a month, Pro 1,200 minutes, and Unlimited has no cap.

faqPairs.question: Do I need to export to Notion or set up PLAUD MCP?
faqPairs.answer: No. PLAUD MCP is PLAUD's official way for ChatGPT or Claude to read your recordings, but SIMY reads your Plaud account directly, so there is no export and no MCP setup.

faqPairs.question: Where is PLAUD based?
faqPairs.answer: PLAUD is developed by Plaud Inc., headquartered in San Francisco, USA.

faqPairs.question: Will my PLAUD recordings be used for AI training or leaked?
faqPairs.answer: PLAUD states that it does not use recordings for AI training without your explicit consent. It complies with SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR and ISO/IEC 27001, and data is stored encrypted. How SIMY handles data is published on our Security and Privacy Policy pages.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to specify my notes format (attendees, agenda, decisions, next steps) every time?
faqPairs.answer: No. Finish one set of notes your way, and SIMY learns it and prepares the same format from the next meeting on. No more pasting transcripts and retyping the same instructions.

faqPairs.question: Who decides what was agreed, the AI or me?
faqPairs.answer: You do. SIMY sorts out candidates from the transcript and summary and takes them as far as a draft, then hands back only what needs your judgment, such as amounts or whether to send.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY work with transcripts from tools other than PLAUD, like Notion AI, Notta or Teams?
faqPairs.answer: This page is about PLAUD, but the SIMY integrations screen also offers other connections such as Notion and Google, which can pass meeting context to SIMY. Check the integrations screen for current support.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY add separate AI usage fees?
faqPairs.answer: SIMY connects to your own ChatGPT account and does the work through the Codex App Server. Codex usage falls within your ChatGPT plan. For SIMY's own pricing, see the pricing page.

faqPairs.question: Do I need consent from the other people before recording?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Get consent from everyone in the conversation before you start recording. SIMY's Terms of Service also make obtaining recording consent the customer's responsibility.

faqPairs.question: What is a local LLM?
faqPairs.answer: It means running the published weights of a model on your own PC or on your company's servers. The text you enter never leaves that machine, so you can use it with confidential documents.

faqPairs.question: What can a local LLM do?
faqPairs.answer: It can summarize and draft confidential documents, answer questions over your internal documents (RAG), and help with translation and code. Small models are better at producing first drafts than final versions.

faqPairs.question: Which local LLM do you recommend?
faqPairs.answer: To try things out, Qwen3 4B to 8B; for a department, Qwen3-14B or 32B, or Qwen3.8-27B; for code, Qwen3-Coder (as of October 2026). Before buying a big GPU, check on the PC you already have whether it works as a first-draft tool.

faqPairs.question: Is Qwen free if I run it locally?
faqPairs.answer: Apache 2.0 models have no usage fees and can be used commercially. But the GPUs, servers, electricity and operations are on you, and some models use their own licenses.

faqPairs.question: What specs do I need to run Qwen locally?
faqPairs.answer: According to Qwen's official figures, Qwen3-8B uses about 16 GB of GPU memory in BF16 and Qwen3-32B about 33 GB in FP8. These figures are mostly the weights; the KV cache grows on top of that in proportion to the number of concurrent users and the context length.

faqPairs.question: Does Qwen3.8-27B run on a single RTX 5090?
faqPairs.answer: A 4-bit quantized version fits on one 32 GB RTX 5090. BF16 needs about 54 GB for the weights alone (a calculated estimate), so it does not fit, and the FP8 version is about 29 GB for the weights alone, so it only fits if you cut the context limit substantially.

faqPairs.question: What is the difference between Ollama and vLLM?
faqPairs.answer: Ollama is for trying things out easily; vLLM is an engine for production use by many people at once. Ollama listens only on 127.0.0.1 by default, but vLLM listens on all interfaces if you omit --host, so always set it.

faqPairs.question: Do I still need updates in a closed network?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. vLLM releases roughly every two weeks, and almost every release includes security fixes. Set up a flow where you fetch updates on a transfer machine and compare them in a test environment before putting them into production.

faqPairs.question: Can Qwen be used commercially?
faqPairs.answer: Apache 2.0 models (such as Qwen3 and Qwen3.8-27B) can be used commercially. Qwen2.5-3B, the 72B models, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and others use different licenses, so check the LICENSE of the model you use with your legal team.

faqPairs.question: Which languages does Qwen support?
faqPairs.answer: Many. With the Qwen3 generation, Qwen claims support for 119 languages and dialects. Small models can sound unnatural in long texts, so check important wording before you use it.

faqPairs.question: Does Qwen run on a Mac?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Ollama, LM Studio and llama.cpp all support the Mac. Apple silicon shares memory with the GPU, so you need memory well above the size of the model file.

faqPairs.question: Is on-premises enough to be safe?
faqPairs.answer: Not on its own. Only once you have decided where it listens, authentication, outbound traffic, logging and access rights to internal documents can you explain that nothing leaves.

faqPairs.question: Can SIMY be used in a closed network?
faqPairs.answer: No. At this time SIMY does not run inside a closed network or offline, and it does not run on Qwen. You can split the work: handle confidential content with Qwen in the closed network, and use SIMY for follow-up work within the scope your company allows.

faqPairs.question: What is Qwen?
faqPairs.answer: Qwen is a family of large language models (LLMs) developed by China's Alibaba Group. You can use it three ways: the free Qwen Chat, the cloud API, and open weights you can run on your own PC.

faqPairs.question: What does the name Qwen stand for?
faqPairs.answer: Qwen is short for its official Chinese name, Tongyi Qianwen.

faqPairs.question: Which country is Qwen from?
faqPairs.answer: China. It is developed by Alibaba Group. The international Qwen Chat is provided by Alibaba Cloud (Singapore), and its privacy policy says input is processed in Singapore.

faqPairs.question: Is Qwen free to use?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. Qwen Chat on the web and the mobile app are free. The API is pay-as-you-go, and open-weight models cost nothing to use if you run them on your own PC (hardware and electricity aside).

faqPairs.question: What languages does Qwen support?
faqPairs.answer: Many. The Qwen3 launch claimed support for 119 languages and dialects. You can ask for translations, summaries and email drafts in a wide range of languages.

faqPairs.question: Can I run Qwen locally on my own PC?
faqPairs.answer: Yes. With Ollama, ollama run qwen3.8 runs the 27B model (about 18 GB), and LM Studio can run the published models too. License and memory needs differ by model, so check How to run Qwen locally.

faqPairs.question: Is what I enter in Qwen Chat used to train AI?
faqPairs.answer: It can be. The privacy policy says anonymized content may be used to improve the models, and that you can stop its use for training by request by email (as of October 2026). For confidential work, consider the API, where you can choose the region, or running locally, where data never leaves.

faqPairs.question: How much does the Qwen API cost?
faqPairs.answer: It varies by model and region. As of October 2026, the top model qwen3.8-max costs $1.65 input and $4.951 output per million tokens (Tokyo and others). It's pay-as-you-go on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and also varies with thinking mode and caching, so check the official pricing page.

faqPairs.question: What is Qwen Code?
faqPairs.answer: An open-source coding agent published by the Qwen team. It reads and writes code from the terminal and connects to Qwen as well as other providers' models and local models.

faqPairs.question: How is Qwen different from ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek?
faqPairs.answer: The big differences are whether you can run the model on your own PC, and where your data goes. Qwen publishes small and mid-size models as open weights, so you can run them locally. For how it differs from DeepSeek, see Chinese AI models (LLMs) compared.

faqPairs.question: Does SIMY run on Qwen?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY does not connect to Qwen at this time. It runs on your ChatGPT (Codex) account and on Claude Code on your PC through the SIMY desktop app. You can keep using Qwen for translation and drafts and leave the follow-through on decisions to SIMY.

faqPairs.question: Do I have to ask SIMY every time to handle the work after Qwen's answer?
faqPairs.answer: No. SIMY picks up decisions, owners and deadlines from meeting records and chats on its own. It learns your way of working from your conversations and returns only what needs your decision.

faqPairs.question: ¿Hay forma de no escribirle a ChatGPT las mismas instrucciones cada vez?
faqPairs.answer: Dentro de ChatGPT hay tres trucos: instrucciones personalizadas, proyectos y GPTs. Pero en todos empiezas tú, y terminan cuando llega la respuesta a ese encargo. SIMY recoge el trabajo de reuniones y chats, lo avanza a tu manera y solo te devuelve decisiones; se suma a esos trucos de ChatGPT, no los sustituye.

faqPairs.question: ¿Cómo evito que ChatGPT entrene con lo que escribo?
